title: HiCAP: Hierarchical Cultural Adaptation via Personality for Dialogue Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.13207v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cultural adaptation in dialogue systems refers to the ability to generate responses that conform to linguistic norms and social expectations across different cultures. However, existing dialogue generation approaches pay limited attention to the role of personality in shaping cultural expression and communication style. We therefore propose HiCAP, a novel framework that integrates personality traits into culturally adaptive dialogue generation. HiCAP employs a personality-conditioned control mechanism that hierarchically modulates response style by first aligning it with the cultural tone and then refining linguistic expression and content according to individual personality attributes. To embed these factors, the model combines supervised fine-tuning and instruction-based tuning, supported by dynamic instruction templates and multi-agent demonstrations to capture diverse combinations of culture and personality. Experiments on CulturalPe

translated_title: HiCAP：基于个性的对话生成分层文化适应框架
translated_abstract: 对话系统中的文化适应是指生成符合不同文化语言规范和社会期望的回应的能力。然而，现有的对话生成方法对个性在塑造文化表达和沟通风格中所起的作用关注有限。因此，我们提出了HiCAP，这是一个将个性特质融入文化自适应对话生成的新型框架。HiCAP采用一种以个性为条件的控制机制，通过分层方式调节回应风格：首先使回应与文化基调保持一致，随后根据个体个性属性对语言表达和内容进行细化。为了嵌入这些因素，该模型结合了监督微调与基于指令的调优，并借助动态指令模板和多智能体演示来捕捉文化与个性的多样化组合。在CulturalPe（数据集）上的实验……
tldr: 提出HiCAP框架，将个性特质通过分层控制机制融入对话生成——先使回应与文化基调对齐、再依据个性细化语言表达与内容，从而实现文化自适应的对话生成。
en_tdlr: HiCAP is a novel framework that integrates personality traits into culturally adaptive dialogue generation via a hierarchical, personality-conditioned control mechanism that first aligns responses with cultural tone and then refines linguistic expression and content according to individual personality attributes.
